propositions: A project-owned code-review criterion must enforce four distinct phase boundaries: Pass 1 discovers grounded findings only without assessment; Pass 2 verifies independently without discovering new findings; Pass 3 applies deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment; Pass 4 coaches without re-verifying or re-adjudicating.
The criterion itself (Pass 1 finder) must emit grounded evidence, never include severity/confidence fields, and leave suggested_fix empty or absent.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire, RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) must achieve recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, stability_min ≥2/3, and kappa ≥0.70 across three calibration runs.
The criterion must activate via .rebar/criteria_routing.json with exec '1-TURN', block_threshold 0.90, and blocking_enabled false; routing is advisory only.
Operative instructions must be distinguishable from documentation, negative examples, and unchanged grandfathered debt; criterion must abstain when phase ownership is unclear.

Implementation must change only project-owned assets (.rebar/ prompt/routing/eval, tests, .gitignore exceptions, and docs/llm-framework.md subsection) and must land on origin/main before dependent stories activate.
